name: Basic shelter
log: You scrape a trench in the lee of the fuselage and roof it with cloth and panel. Four hours of sweat. The hole is ugly. At noon it will feel like mercy.

name: Fire pit
log: A ring of stones and a careful flame. It will cook, take the edge off the night, and keep small hunters out of the blankets.
already: The fire pit is already built.

name: Solar still
log: Plastic over a pit, a cup at the bottom, tubing so you can drink without breaking the seal. By dawn it will have sweated a little water.
washLog: You cut the still into the lowest sand of the wash. The ground here is less unwilling. It should give more than a still beside the wreck.
unknownDetail: You have plastic, a container, and tubing. You can spend three hours finding out if they belong together.

name: Signal fire
log: You build the fire into a column of smoke. It will eat a bundle of fuel at every dawn. If a search is out there, this is how they choose your square.
already: The signal fire is already burning.

relight.log: You feed the beacon until the smoke stands up again.
